The Perceptual Quality Auditor's finding of 'slight compression' (0.2) is negligible compared to the structural artifacts. A new artifact to note is the 'waxy' smoothing of the crowd's clothing and skin, consistent with AI generative priors, which contributes to the overall uncanny valley effect.

While not catastrophic, these are clear indicators of AI generation that detract from photorealism.
